//dependencies-registry-notes.@perspective-dev/*: Pinned to the stable 4.5.2 line, NOT 5.0.0. The 5.0.0 major was published 2026-07-28 and is too fresh to pin a data plane to; 4.5.2 is the settled line. All four Perspective packages MUST move together — they share the wasm protocol. Successor to @finos/perspective (3.8.0 was the last FINOS release; the project moved to the perspective-dev org at 4.0). 4.x carries the fixes for the two 'View op concurrent with Table::update' segfaults that 3.8 shipped with.
